_comment: Fine-tunes pretrained RoBERTa-base weights (from spaCy en_core_web_trf 3.8.0, MIT; converted and verified by scripts/convert_spacy_roberta.py), keeping the first 6 of 12 layers so the int8 ONNX artifact fits GitHub's 100 MB file limit and runs fast on CPU. Embeddings frozen and a 32k-row stratified subsample to fit 2 CPU cores. This produced the shipped artifacts/engine2/default.
